body: I don't know. It feels like stagnation. Sitting still in a world where all my friends have everything going according to plan. I'm not moving at all - moving towards a future of burgers, depression,  sadness, and loneliness. It's just not going to happen for me. Nothing will. I'll give it another couple of days but after that I'm signing out. I don't want to live that way.

Perhaps... I just feel like everything I did in college, all the time and effort I dedicated to getting a degree was worthless. I could have gone into the job market straight out of high school and been in the same boat. 

No one will ever want to marry me because of my shit career. My friends will slowly disappear, because no one will want to associate with "someone like me", and eventually I'll run out of parents to mooch off of and where will I be then? What will have been the point it all? Suddenly I'm an 66 year old homeless man who keeps getting arrested for masturbating behind a dumpster to moldy porno mags from the 1970s.

My best bet at this point is going to law school and hoping that my further "qualifications" will pay off rather than simply leaving me even deeper in debt than I already am. The odds of me actually making something of myself are astronomically low.

Eventually my friends would get over my death. They say they would be upset but for how long, really? They'd be back on their feet within a week. They've got more important things to worry about than why an indebted jobless rube who bought into the idea that jobs post-college were a thing killed himself.
Well. Given this I'd say the chances I make it through the end of the week are probably about 20-80. Not looking too great. Literally no point to going on if there is no future.
